purpose: Freeze the first payoff-aligned full-market short-horizon policy that passed the historical candidate gate, without promoting adaptive 2012-2025 evidence to a stable-profit claim.

frozen_policy.stock_score: equal average of within-date percentile ranks from the lookback-8 payoff sequence model and the 557-field exact-net-D5 LambdaRank model

market_gate.tree: Ridge predicted market mean D5 exact net return above zero AND logistic positive probability above 0.5
market_gate.sequence: neural market-return head above zero AND neural positive probability above 0.5
market_gate.combined: tree and sequence gates must both be true

frozen_policy.selection: Top10 by the frozen stock score on an active market-gate date
frozen_policy.entry: next open market order subject to legal fill constraints
frozen_policy.exit: D3 close request, otherwise first legally sellable open
frozen_policy.sizing: one third of previous account equity per signal cohort, divided equally across the ten requested names and capped by available cash
frozen_policy.execution: 100-share lots, minimum commission, transfer fee, stamp tax, suspensions, price limits and double slippage

direct_d3_rank.reason: D3 ranking was weaker than D5 ranking and its absolute stress Top1, Top3 and Top10 gates failed.

d3_q10_bottom_decile_veto.reason: The fixed bottom-10-percent conditional-tail veto reduced return and improved drawdown only marginally, so it did not justify another live model.

next_boundary.next_required_artifact: outcome-blind inference snapshot plus frozen final model bundle
next_boundary.next_required_evidence: append-only post-freeze shadow signals and legal fills
